nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess... I guess we don't have a choice!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: And just for forcing us to do this... Let's give those Wilson kids exactly what they deserve!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh, no offense, Sarah.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: None taken.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Okay. Sarah, can you figure out what's going on with the float? Maybe where they're keeping it?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I... I can try.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Perfect! Then we'll regroup here tomorrow morning and put together a game plan.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Have you done this before?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You really don't want me to answer that.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yikes!
And so... The next morning...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Here's what I've got figured out.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: The float is in the Wilson High Auto-Shop. They haven't changed it yet, but they might repaint it any time.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Just to be on the safe side, Alexei's got all the Wilson High shop kids guarding it 24/7.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Grr... I hate those guys!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: It gets worse. Since they're planning on building a separate badger head to make it their own mascot...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Alexei cut off your mechanical lizard's head and is carrying it around in his backpack!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Today's Saturday, and the parade is tomorrow at noon... That means we're going to have to get it off him tonight.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: That won't be easy. He's throwing a huge party at his house tonight, and it's rigged with the latest in home security!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This is impossible...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: What did I tell you before? Nothing's impossible!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But we're gonna need help.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We'll need someone to work a hustle on the guards and be a decoy... And we'll need a geek to crack that security system...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I'm guessing you two are sophomores, right? No driver's licenses?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Nope.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sorry.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Then we'll need someone with wheels to drive us around.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: A decoy... A hacker... And a getaway driver...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Which one should we get first?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: No way! Alexei's dad is a cop, and if the rumors are true, he's not exactly on the level!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: If Alexei gets word that the cops are onto him, he'll just destroy the float!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Besides... It's not like we have any proof that we're the ones who built it.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: If the cops ask, it'll just be our word against his.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's... That's so unfair.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: That's life. And you can either let it bite you... Or you can bite back.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And right now, I'm in one heck of a biting mood!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Kind of creepy, but I don't see a better alternative.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: You've got to be kidding! The only thing that'll do is let them know we're onto them!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Lull them into a false sense of complacency... I like it!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Maybe we could offer to meet with them to discuss it... And then ambush them!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You really are pretty devious, Linda!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: That's not what I meant...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Look, let's not get ahead of ourselves. The point is, we have to steal it!

nodes.title: Assembling the Team!
nodes.subtitle: The Decoy, The Hacker, and The Driver!

nodes.text: In our last episode...
The Wilson High kids stole the Centerscore float so they could use it to win the `$10,000` prize!
nodes.text_bbcode: The Wilson High kids stole the Centerscore float so they could use it to win the [b]$10,000[/b] prize!

nodes.text: It's up to Linda, Kenji, and Sarah to steal it back from the villainous Alexei... But do they have what it takes?
Play on and find out!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We worked on that float for hours. We designed it. We built it. We painted it...

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: And now they're going to claim it's theirs? And they're going to win the town prize?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: No way. Not on my watch. We're gonna steal it back!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: 'Fight fire with fire and theft with theft', like my old man used to say... Before he got locked up, that is.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I hate to betray Wilson... But I think Kenji is right!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I always had my doubts about Alexei... And I'm not going to be a part of this horrible plan!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I'd rather lose the competition than win by cheating!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: How about you, Linda? Are you on board?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... I think we should first try...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But why, O fair princess, why must thou hurt my feelings so?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Am I not thy truest of true friends? Would thee not describe us as the most BFF of BFFS?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Nay, kind Sir Dubble, thou art not.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: For as kind as thy words may be, my heart doth beat for another!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Alas! Alas! Alas!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Aaaaaaand scene!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Wow, darling, that was fantastic!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I truly felt the characters there... I felt the deep-seated betrayal, the unrequited love!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: You must become more involved in the craft! You're a natural! You're beautiful! You're divine!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I guess!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Would you like to run another scene?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I'm sorry, darling, but I just don't think this is the right task for me. It's just too... Mundane.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I only work with the very best... And well...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I just don't think you have an appreciation of the craft!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hey! I appreciate arts and crafts just fine!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: See? You're just proving my point.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Your ignorance is positively tragic!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Yeah... Well... So are you!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Nice comeback, Linda. Real nice.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: You couldn't get her on board? That's going to make things really tricky...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm sorry...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: And why would I possibly want that?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You don't... Like sets?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Sets merely distract from the actors on the stage!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Any buffoon in a t-shirt can hammer together two pieces of plywood!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Only a true thespian can convey joy... Sorrow... Regret...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I would sooner act on a bare stage than earn the school more money for garish sets!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I'm sorry, Mona.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Oh, it's all right, darling. You can't be expected to understand the subtleties of the craft!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I honestly didn't mean to offend you... I just really need your help!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Darling, do I look like I need a fancy costume?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Maybe not... But did you see what the Wilson High kids were wearing for their last play?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: The girl playing the lead got the `nicest` dress... And some really expensive shoes...
nodes.text_bbcode: The girl playing the lead got the [color=#3b78e2][i]nicest[/i][/color] dress... And some really expensive shoes...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It just made her performance that much more believable!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Well that's just... I mean I... If she needs...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Grr! `$10,000`, you say? That is awfully tempting...
nodes.text_bbcode: Grr! [color=#3b78e2][i]$10,000[/i][/color], you say? That is awfully tempting...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: So you'll help us?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: O terrible prince! O awful, awful man! How darest thou condemn me so?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Perhaps I was too harsh. Yes. This is possible.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But I still will not let you marry that wizard.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I drop to my knees in desperation! O most wicked of men! O most vile of creatures!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I am unmoved by your words.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ha. Ha. Ha.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Look, I'm sorry. This just isn't working.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What's wrong?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: You've got no emotion! You're like some kind of robot!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Where's the passion, darling? Where's the raw, burning emotion?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I... I don't know...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Ugh, maybe we can try a different scene...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: O angry lords! O monstrous winds! Consume me now, lest I dare to love again!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Let's see here...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Just end my torment today!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: No, no, that's my line!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Oh, sorry... I mean...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Consume me now, lest I dare to love again!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: No! That's `also` my line! And I've already read that one!
nodes.text_bbcode: No! That's [color=#3b78e2][i]also[/i][/color] my line! And I've already read that one!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Let's just skip it...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: My love shall not be broken by rock, nor by rocket launcher...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: My love shall not be broken by rock, nor by rocket launcher!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Just forget it, okay? This isn't working at all!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Maybe you can help by just watching me read the lines and clapping...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: But anyway, darling, enough about that... You must get going! I have absolutely no time for frivolity! I've only got another hour to practice my lines!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well... Why don't I stay and help?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It's always easier to study if you have a partner!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I don't know... This play truly requires the heights of dramatic performance...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: And if you're not convincing, I'm not sure I'll be able to truly sink my teeth into the part!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Why don't you give it a shot? Maybe I'll surprise you!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Hmm... Well... No harm in trying!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Yay! You got it! I was Princess Conceptia from the Shlockspeare play 'Twelve Wives of Woxley'!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: That's my favorite scene... When she realizes that her love, Prince Herbert, isn't coming home from France!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Oh... It brings a tear to my eye... And I am so impressed that you recognized it!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: You always did know your theater!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Talk about a lucky guess!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: A dying witch? No, not at all!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: I'm Princess Conceptia!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Sorry, that doesn't ring a bell...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Princess Conceptia? From 'Twelve Wives of Woxley'? By Wilford Shlockspeare?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I guess I haven't read it.

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Ugh! Ugh! How truly uncultured!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: A decoy, huh? Do we know any hustlers? Con men? Tricksters? Scammers? Outright thieves?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I know a girl who does a lot of theater.

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Perfect! Let's go to the auditorium!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Actually, I think it might be for the best if I went alone...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: This girl can be... Delicate.
Linda heads over to the theater building, when suddenly, her phone rings!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: A text message... From Howard?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: 'hey linda, what r u doing later? want 2 hang out? -howard'

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hang out?! I don't have time to hang out... And I wouldn't be in this mess if he'd helped me with the float to begin with! Hmph!
Linda slams the phone shut and keeps walking.
Linda heads over to the school theater.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Hello? Mona? Are you in here?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: The darkness! The darkness! It hangs so thick o'er my eyes!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uhhh... Mona?

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Prithee, art thou my love? Or art thou...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: `A SPECTRE OF DEATH?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]A SPECTRE OF DEATH?![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Aaaah!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Oh come, royal torments! Oh end, noble vows!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Now die...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Die...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Die!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Sorry about that, darling, just doing a little acting! You know how it goes!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Ha ha... Acting... Right...

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: What did you think of my performance?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: It was, um, very compelling!

nodes.speaker: Mona
nodes.text: Oh really? Could you tell who I was supposed to be?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Uh... Of course!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: You were a...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: But that's... That's impossible! No one's ever matched me!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Maybe you just haven't found the right opponent!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: And unless I'm mistaken... You just left your champion exposed!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What?! No! Wizards! I need wizards! `WHERE ARE MY WIZARDS?!`
nodes.text_bbcode: What?! No! Wizards! I need wizards! [color=#e23b3b][i]WHERE ARE MY WIZARDS?![/i][/color]

nodes.text: Sarah hits Ogg'Thokk with everything she's got!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I guess we're just going to have to do this without a hacker...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I'm sorry, guys...
Back at the Auto-Shop...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: A favor? For you? Are you kidding? After the way you played?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I beat you fair and square!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Luck! All luck! Beginner's luck! Girl luck!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Seriously, Spud, we really need your help!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Too bad! Maybe you ought to roll for it!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: That doesn't even make sense!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I attack Ogg'Thokk with Sarah, Queen of the Amazons!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: It's over. I'm finished. You... You've won.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: The Great Dynasty of Spud the Stupendous has come to an end! Sarah the Splendid reigns supreme!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Wooo! Go me! I'm the best! I am the queen!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Uh... I mean... Spud, now that this is over, I have a favor to ask you...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Uh, no offense, but after the way you just played, I don't think I trust your leadership.

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Are you serious? Come on! It was just a game!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: 'Ogres and Elves' is `NOT` just a game!
nodes.text_bbcode: 'Ogres and Elves' is [color=#e23b3b][i]NOT[/i][/color] just a game!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: It's a way of life!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Are you serious?!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: If you don't appreciate that, there's no way I'd be part of your team!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I choose to spare Ogg'Thokk. In fact, I revive him to full health.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Huh? Why?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: The truth is, Spud, I don't really want to win. I only played so I could ask you to do me a favor...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: You did?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: In that case... I attack your champion with Ogg'Thokk!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Double fives! Yes! That's a `Fatal Death Chop!` I win! I win! I'm the best!
nodes.text_bbcode: Double fives! Yes! That's a [color=#e23b3b][i]Fatal Death Chop![/i][/color] I win! I win! I'm the best!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I... I was being nice...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Spud is still awesome!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Yes, he is!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Spud is still the champ!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Yes, he is!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Now, what was this favor you wanted?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: We're planning a raid on a Wilson High kid, and we need you to crack a security system!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Not bad, not bad... But not enough to defeat my wizard!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I didn't beat him?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Well, technically, you annoyed him enough that he took a two-turn sabbatical.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: But he'll be back!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: That's well and good for him... Because I'm attacking your champion!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I cast Blistering Agony!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Uh... Uh... Uh... I cast Mild Discomfort?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Ha! Wrong again! I win the duel!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: And that means your wizard is mine!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Fine... But I'm attacking your champion!
Sarah and Spud compete furiously, sliding pieces around and rolling dice.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Ha! You've moved your Platypus Knights right into the line of my Scandinavian Sniper Regiment!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Try using them without exposing your Elven Notary Public!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: What the... Arggggh!
Some more rolls... Some more moves...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: What? Why did you just take my Pretty Pony Platoon?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Oh, are you not familiar with the 2.5.6.2.4.3 Ruleset? Pony Platoons are weak to polio!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: No! Not my pretty ponies!
And suddenly... Spud pulls out a deck of brightly colored playing cards!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I'm attacking your wizard with my sorcerer... That means it's time for...

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: `A MAGIC DUEL!`
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#e23b3b][i]A MAGIC DUEL![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Ooooo I love Magic Duels!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Huh? I don't think I've done this before... My brother never had playing cards...

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Spud's going to throw spells at you, and you've got to pick the right counterspell!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Shut up, Dexter!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: And remember, every spell has a logical counterspell!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: I said `SHUT UP!`
nodes.text_bbcode: I said [color=#e23b3b][i]SHUT UP![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Logical opposite, huh? I bet I can do this!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: It's on!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Oh ho! A daring choice! You must be prepared to sweep the land clean of evil!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Too bad for you that Ogg'Thokk Warkitten gets +12 `Bloodrage` against Janitors!
nodes.text_bbcode: Too bad for you that Ogg'Thokk Warkitten gets +12 [color=#e23b3b][i]Bloodrage[/i][/color] against Janitors!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: He `hates` those guys! It's almost pathological!
nodes.text_bbcode: He [color=#e23b3b][i]hates[/i][/color] those guys! It's almost pathological!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Oh yeah? Well... That was part of my plan!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Hmph!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Actually... I'd completely forgotten!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Oh, uh, are you sure you want that piece? It's really not good...

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: I'm sure. Let's do this!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Well played, strange girl, well played. You know your 'Ogres and Elves' lore well!

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Ogg'Thokk Warkitten's only weakness is a beautiful woman... He loses 11 points of `Confidence` when he fights one!
nodes.text_bbcode: Ogg'Thokk Warkitten's only weakness is a beautiful woman... He loses 11 points of [color=#e23b3b][i]Confidence[/i][/color] when he fights one!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Why am I not surprised?

nodes.speaker: Spud
nodes.text: Well, I don't care! I can take you down even if I'm cursed with `Crippling Insecurity!`
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, I don't care! I can take you down even if I'm cursed with [color=#e23b3b][i]Crippling Insecurity![/i][/color]

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Bring it on!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: I think I know just the guy!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Oh?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Do you guys know Spud?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Last year, he got in a ton of trouble for hacking into Mr. Biddle's email and mailing everyone pictures from his Italy trip...

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Let's just say those European guys wear some pretty tiny swim trunks!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Sounds like this Spud is our guy!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: So where do we find him?
The three of them wander into the Centerscore arcade and find it packed full of nerds, dweebs, and other assorted geeks.
Most of them are crowded around a long table covered in dozens of tiny pewter figurines of elves, trolls, dwarves, and other creatures!
Spud sits at the head of the table, proudly moving his pieces around.

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What is this?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: It's the eighth annual 'Ogres and Elves' Tabletop Tournament!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Well, is Spud going to be busy? We need to talk to him!

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Spud is the reigning champion, noob. And he's certain to win!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: We just need to get a couple words in.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Trust me. You don't want to interrupt his concentration. Spud's not talking to anyone unless they're playing 'Ogres and Elves'!

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Well in that case... Where do I sign up?

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: Seriously?

nodes.speaker: Sarah
nodes.text: Look, don't tell anyone, but I used to play this game with my brother all the time.

nodes.speaker: Dexter
nodes.text: Well, there's a big line to play... But we've got a special `Girls Play First` policy!
nodes.text_bbcode: Well, there's a big line to play... But we've got a special [color=#e23b3b][i]Girls Play First[/i][/color] policy!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: Really?

nodes.speaker: Dexter

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: No! It doesn't! Arrrrggghhh!
Wow. It would take someone exceptionally cold-hearted to give Linda such a bad ending!
Give it another shot, and see if you can't get her a better fate!

args.text: Try again! We know you can do it!

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: But I guess there's nothing we can do except hope we don't set it off!
The next day... In Principal Shapiro's office!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: I am very, very disappointed in both of you! What were you thinking?

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Trying to steal the Wilson High float is an extremely serious offense!

nodes.speaker: Linda
nodes.text: But Principal Shapiro, you have to understand... It was `our` float! They stole it first!
nodes.text_bbcode: But Principal Shapiro, you have to understand... It was [color=#3b78e2][i]our[/i][/color] float! They stole it first!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Even if that's true, you should have come to me, not try to steal it back!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: And what I can't believe is that you almost got away with it... If only you'd had one more person on your merry little team!

nodes.speaker: Shapiro
nodes.text: Thank goodness you didn't!
Yikes! And to think that if only you'd gotten the whole team together, things might have gone completely differently...
Why don't you try again, and see if you can't get all three students on your side?

nodes.speaker: Kenji
nodes.text: I guess we couldn't get everyone on board, huh?
